correctness.rationale: The complete three-colour skeleton has 12 vertices, 48 cross-colour edges and 48 allowed triangles c!=L(i,j). Each pair restriction is uniform and surjective (3 and 4 preimages) but 16 forbidden complete label triples do not extend. Independent enumeration of all 576 order-four Latin squares via row/column constraints, and all row/column/symbol isotopies, produces precisely disjoint orbits 432 (Z4) and 144 (Klein). Independently built 48x48 signed integral boundary matrices: cyclic Smith 37 ones, Klein 36 ones plus one 2; connected 1-skeleton has d1 rank11, so both H2=Z11, cyclic H1=0 and Klein H1=Z2. Inspected exact 37-generator van Kampen presentation and deterministic legitimate one-occurrence Tietze eliminations, leaving empty presentation in cyclic case and <t|t^2> in Klein. Simply connected cyclic 2D CW with H2 Z11 is wedge of 11 S2 via Hurewicz/Whitehead. Scope is all Latin tables of order four only.
